title: Gotta Get Started Somewhere
description: I’m starting this Substack newsletter for several reasons.
body_html:
I’m starting this Substack newsletter for several reasons. First, I want to give people a reality check regarding trading. This isn’t an easy business at all. After over 20 years of trading the markets, I’ve had highs and lows along the way. Like most traders, I started with a dream of growing rich quickly. I quickly learned the doubled edged sword of lack of a plan and lack of risk control. As the story goes, I proceeded to put all of my money into call options of a biotech stock that claimed it would cure cancer. That was when I learned the hard way about FDA approvals and options volatility. Needless to say, the $8 calls I bought a few days prior went down to $.80 overnight when the trials didn’t go as planned. Wiped out. The $10,000 or so I had saved up to that point, instead of making me rich, made me realize I had no idea what I was doing. This was the first of several blowups I experienced over the ensuing 15 years of trading, mostly rooted in a complete lack of respect for risk and overuse of leveraged products. Beyond the blowup in options, I’ve also blown up accounts in forex (how does 100x leverage on a $10,000 account sound?), futures twice, and stocks once. Respect for risk was a hard lesson for me to learn.

The second reason I wanted to start this newsletter was to educate traders who are really interested in sound trading principles. I’ve spent thousands of hours and tens of thousands of dollars on courses, books, seminars, services - you name it. I made it my personal mission to study the best traders, past and present, to determine what made them great. Livermore, Darvas, Baruch, Loeb, O’Neil, Zanger, Minervini, Schwartz, Weinstein (Stan and Mark), Stockbee, Kacher, Morales, Kristjan Qullamaggie, and many others. Those stories of greatness kept me motivated when the going got tough. I’ve come to learn there are no Holy Grails or magic indicators. While there are many tactics to approach trading, there are core principles that, if violated, will cut your trading journey short. So rather than ranting on Twitter like an incoherent drunk, I thought this platform would be a useful way to capture my thoughts in a more structured manner. This way, I can use it as a diary of sorts - something I can go back to and study my thinking and how things progressed.

With that out of the way, I intend to publish a newsletter several times a month. This will include my analysis of the current market environment using what I’ve learned from other great traders and my own proprietary indicators developed through 2 decades in the trenches. I’ll also post thoughts on other important aspects of trading, like risk control, position management, psychology, and a lot more. While I can’t guarantee you you’ll become rich, I can assure you that you’ll learn a lot about staying on the correct side of the market. I’m not a professional trader - yet - one too many setbacks in the past slowed down my journey. But I’m confident, based on the last few years of results, that I’m not far off of that goal with the right market environment. If nothing else, I can help you stop doing dumb things and become a more consistent, confident operator. Let’s begin our journey.

Thanks for reading DTF Newsletter! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
